 """Database lookup helpers."""
+
+
+def find_orders(cursor, request):
+    """Return matching IDs; callers handle database failures."""
+    query = "".join(
+        ("SELECT id FROM orders WHERE owner = '", request.args["owner"], "'")
+    )
+    cursor.execute(query)
+    return cursor.fetchall()
